capabilities: Define alias groups mapping aliases to a primary tag
Intercept tag autocomplete to suggest and insert the primary tag
Auto-replace alias tags that slip through
Scan the vault and batch-replace existing alias tags
Export and import the alias configuration as JSON
extras: Community-plugin installation is listed as 'coming soon'; manual installation from release files is the documented path.
intentEvidence: Overrides Obsidian's tag autocomplete with alias-aware suggestions
problem: Notes end up with many inconsistent tags for the same concept, so tag-based search and views miss notes.

summary: Tag alias manager that maps alias tags to primary tags, inserting the canonical tag at input time and batch-replacing existing aliases.
